questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (around 00:09-00:12), there are exactly three pens arranged in a row.
All three pens have the dark cap/end at the bottom and the clear barrel at the top. Although the rightmost pen is tilted, it is not flipped opposite to the others; they all point generally 'down'.
All three pens appear to be identical black ink pens with translucent barrels and black caps/ends.
All pens appear to have their caps on (dark end visible) and are of equal length.
The board moves steadily from left to right throughout the entire clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their positions relative to the board as it slides.

parsed.reason: The video shows a board with three identical pens moving smoothly from left to right. All pens are capped, same color, and oriented with the cap down, satisfying the nominal conditions.

description: One pen is flipped relative to the others (variant).
